## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 1551 invitations during the reporting period. Of those invited, 203 people attended. This represents an attendance rate of 13.1. The figures provide a concise view of participation following the invitation process and support ongoing review of outreach activity. Attendance remains the central measure used in this summary, with the number invited providing the relevant context for interpreting the result.

The invitation process included direct contact by SMS. This approach was used to support awareness of the opportunity to attend and to provide a clear communication channel for invitees.

## Contact

An SMS was sent with 1332 invitations. A reminder message was also received by 1332 people. These contacts formed part of the communication activity associated with the invitations and were intended to reinforce the information provided to invitees.

Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, maintaining contact with those who may need further support to engage. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
